lines.text: Many learners say: She has long hairs.

native.tip: hair 指头发时是不可数名词，不加 s。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “She has long hairs.”？😅 hair 指整头头发时不可数，不加 s：“She has long hair.”。跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“hair”。hair 不可数！免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Hair is uncountable, so do not add an s.
en.caption: Do you say “She has long hairs.”? 😅 Hair is uncountable when it means all the hair on the head: “She has long hair.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
